记下你用了哪些控件、各用了多少次，帮你看清自己的使用习惯。默认关闭，打开之前什么: Notes which controls you use and how often, so you can see your own habits. Off by default; nothing is recorded until you turn it on.
只记录你用了哪些控件、各用了多少次（按天累计）。: Records only which controls you use and how often, counted per day.
不记录你输入、阅读或回答的任何内容，也不记录任何文件、课程或资料的名字。: Never what you typed, read or answered, and never a file, course or source name.
只保存在这台电脑上，不在学习库里（备份和导出学习库都不带它）；StudyHub: Stays on this computer, outside your library (backups and library exports do not include it), and is never sent anywhere by StudyHub.
你可以随时查看、导出、暂停和删除。: You can view, export, pause and delete it at any time.
关掉后，已有的记录保留，可以继续查看、导出或删除。: When it is off, what was recorded is kept; you can still view, export or delete it.
正在记录。还没有记录：照常使用 StudyHub，过一两天再来看。: Recording. Nothing recorded yet: use StudyHub as usual and look back in a day or two.
正在记录。已有 {0} 天的记录（从 {1} 起）。: Recording. {0} days of records so far (since {1}).
已暂停：继续记录之前，不会记任何东西。: Paused: nothing is recorded until you resume.
已关闭：不再记录。之前的记录还在，可以继续查看、导出或删除。: Off: no longer recording. What was recorded is still here to view, export or delete.
将删除所有已记录的次数和日期。不影响学习库，也不改变记录开关。: This deletes every recorded count and day. Your library is not affected, and the switch stays as it is.
之后可以重新开始记录；已经导出的文件不受影响。: You can start recording again later; files you already exported are not affected.
用到这些控件时，你正在哪个页面。: The page you were on when you used them.
按每个控件本来在什么时候用来归类：每天、阶段性、一次性。: Grouped by when each control is meant to be used: every day, now and then, once per course.
这段时间没有记录。: Nothing was recorded in this period.
这些功能在记录期间一次都没被用过：可能你不需要，也可能你不知道它在那里。: These were not used even once while recording was on: you may not need them, or may not know they are there.
这些只是提示，每一条都可以不管。: These are only suggestions; each one is optional.
没有完成，请再试一次。: That did not work; please try again.
这个窗口不允许复制；请改用「导出 Markdown」。: This window does not allow copying; use “Export Markdown” instead.
